timeline.summary: Mamata Machinery scheduled its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call for June 1, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹73.75 Cr (-33.6% YoY), net profit ₹0.01 Cr (-100.0% YoY).
Mamata Machinery reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹233 Cr and PAT of ₹15.05 Cr, impacted by US tariff headwinds.
Mahendra N. Patel, Promoter, declared no encumbrances on 15,367,570 Mamata Machinery shares by promoter group for FY2026.
